title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
source: Franklin Square Song Collection, No. 1 (1881), p. 69, Row Your Boat
flow: Sing together, or as a round: Group 2 starts when Group 1 reaches "Gently down the stream."

title: She'll Be Comin' Round the Mountain
source: Carl Sandburg, The American Songbag (1927), pp. 372-373, song A

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: She'll be comin' round the mountain,
She'll be comin' round the mountain,
She'll be comin' round the mountain,
She'll be comin' round the mountain,
She'll be comin' round the mountain,

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: She'll be drivin' six white horses,
She'll be drivin' six white horses,
She'll be drivin' six white horses,
She'll be drivin' six white horses,
She'll be drivin' six white horses,

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Oh we'll all go to meet her,
Oh we'll all go to meet her,
We will kill the old red rooster,
We will kill the old red rooster,
And we'll all have chicken and dumplin',

flow: Sing Verses 1-3 in order. 'When she comes' is part of each verse; there is no separate chorus.
teaching: Use the familiar mountain-song tune and keep a steady beat. In Verse 3, the words change halfway through: meet her, red rooster, then chicken and dumplin'.

title: B-I-N-G-O
source: Stanford DREME, Math Song Guide Based on BINGO (2022), Song Lyrics panel; who selected from printed optional (who)

sections.label: Pass 1 · Sing all letters
lines: There was a farmer who had a dog,

sections.label: Pass 2 · Clap for B
lines: There was a farmer who had a dog,

flow: Sing Pass 1, then Pass 2 with a clap in place of B. On each later pass, replace one more letter with a clap.
repeatCue: Repeat the whole verse for each pass below. Sing each spelling pattern three times; keep the first two lines and final name-o line the same.

title: John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt
source: LowGUkulele.com, John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt - Low G Ukulele, Level 1 (May 5, 2025), traditional lyric underlay only

sections.label: Pass 1 · Normal voice
lines: His name is my name too!
They say John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt,

sections.label: Pass 2 · Quieter voice
lines: His name is my name too!
They say John Jacob Jingleheimer Schmidt,

flow: Sing Pass 2 more quietly than Pass 1, then keep getting quieter on later repeats. Sing the Fa-la ending loudly every time.
